hooks.prompt: Check if the file being written follows dbt naming conventions (stg_, int_, fct_, dim_ prefixes) and SQL style rules from references/style-and-conventions.md. If violations found, list them. $ARGUMENTS
If the file just written is a staging model, verify it follows the CTE structure (source, renamed, final) defined in references/staging-sql-conventions.md. $ARGUMENTS

Review this session. If cross-agent project decisions were made — naming conventions, modeling choices, source configurations — update the relevant files in .claude/memory/. Do NOT update .claude/agent-memory/ here; agents manage that automatically. Only update if substantive shared decisions were made.
